summary: Lock pilot-only estimate: stability screen + tuned GBM, honest 2x5 CV
reasoning: Lock run: `uv run python analysis.py --pilot-only`. The locked procedure = bootstrap ET-importance stability screen (64 resamples, top-30 flag, keep freq>=0.50, cap 50) + HistGradientBoostingClassifier tuned on pilot (3-fold, 16-pt grid); cv_auc is the honest estimate of the whole procedure (screen+tuning refitted inside each of 2x5 outer folds). Pilot-only exploration measured honest CV 0.740-0.753 for this screen family (and 0.78 with RF), and stable-forest's convergent GINI screen reached 0.7554 honest (step-56, builds_on). I therefore expect cv_auc in ~0.73-0.78 (>= 0.70) with n_features ~6-15 (<= 50). Heldout is not touched in this run; if cv_auc < 0.70 I will not proceed to scoring heldout with this procedure.
